record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Asymptotic Geometric Analysis
record.original_question: For a fixed p > 0 and an n-dimensional convex body K, choose n+1 points x_1, ..., x_{n+1} independently and uniformly in K and let m_p(K) be the normalized p-th moment of the volume of the random simplex conv{x_1, ..., x_{n+1}}. Determine, up to nondegenerate affine transformations, which convex bodies minimize m_p(K) and which convex bodies maximize m_p(K); in particular, settle the open maximization direction in dimensions n >= 3.

evidence.quote: In the opposite direction the problem is open if n >= 3.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ be an integer and let $p>0$ be fixed. For a convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ (a compact convex set with nonempty interior) of volume $|K|>0$, let $X_1,\dots,X_{n+1}$ be independent random points distributed uniformly in $K$, and define the normalized $p$-th moment of the random-simplex volume by
$$m_p(K)\;=\;\frac{\mathbb{E}\bigl[\,\mathrm{vol}_n(\mathrm{conv}\{X_1,\dots,X_{n+1}\})^{p}\,\bigr]}{|K|^{p}}.$$
The quantity $m_p(K)$ is invariant under nondegenerate affine transformations of $K$.

(a) Determine all convex bodies $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, up to nondegenerate affine transformations, that minimize $m_p(K)$ among all $n$-dimensional convex bodies.

(b) Determine all convex bodies $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, up to nondegenerate affine transformations, that maximize $m_p(K)$ among all $n$-dimensional convex bodies. In particular, settle this maximization problem for every dimension $n\ge 3$ (it is conjectured that the maximizers are exactly the simplices).
artifact.status_search_result: The minimizer direction is classically known to be ellipsoids (Groemer), while the maximization direction—conjecturally simplices—remains open for dimensions n ≥ 3. Recent literature confirms only partial results: the planar case is settled (triangles maximize, due to Blaschke), structural results show that polytopal local maximizers with a simplicial vertex must be simplices, and various symmetric/related variants have been studied, but the general maximizer problem in n ≥ 3 is still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Sylvester's Problem for Symmetric Convex Bodies and Related Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Considers moments of random polytopes in symmetric convex bodies; conjectures that only maximizers are simplices.
status_evidence.claim: The maximizer-is-a-simplex conjecture is stated and only partial structural results are known.

status_evidence.title: On the monotonicity of the expected volume of a random simplex
status_evidence.snippet: Monotonicity of expected simplex volume fails for d ≥ 4; related extremal problems for moments of random simplices remain open in higher dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: Higher-dimensional extremal problems for moments of random simplex volume are not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: A refinement of the Sylvester problem: Probabilities of combinatorial types
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) refinement of the Sylvester problem, indicating ongoing research activity.
status_evidence.claim: The maximization direction remains an active open research topic.
